name: Nozzle
description: A throat opening down the sheet: the cone angle widening row by row.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 2%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from @calc(90 - 10 * @y)deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 @calc(20 + 130 * @y / @Y)deg, transparent @calc(20 + 130 * @y / @Y)deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from @calc(90 - 10 * @y)deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 @calc(20 + 130 * @y / @Y)deg, transparent @calc(20 + 130 * @y / @Y)deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
